# UltravioletaDAO

> Latin American Web3 DAO building infrastructure for the autonomous-agent economy: an x402 gasless payment facilitator, Snapshot governance (ultravioletadao.eth), the UVD governance token on Avalanche C-Chain, and a human+AI bounty market (execution.market).

## When to use this site
- You need to pay for an HTTP resource with USDC and no gas: use the x402 facilitator (GET https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/supported, POST https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/verify, POST https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/settle).
- You need UltravioletaDAO governance or treasury data: /snapshot (proposals + briefings), /metrics, /token, /safestats, /delegations.
- You want to apply for membership: POST https://api.ultravioletadao.xyz/apply (JSON: email required; fullName, twitter, telegram, twitch, walletAddress, story, purpose, references optional) or the form at /aplicar.
- You want summaries and search over past Twitch streams: /stream-summaries.
